fullDesc: In 1979 mass protests forced the Shah of Iran to leave, and Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini returned from exile to found an Islamic republic. The US embassy was seized in November, and 52 Americans were held for 444 days.
realFacts: Khomeini was supreme leader until his death in 1989
Relations with the US have been tense ever since
The hostages were freed in January 1981
